args: customMetrics | where name == 'no.such.metric' | extend series=tostring(customDimensions) | order by series asc, timestamp asc | serialize | extend prev = prev(value), prev_series = prev(series) | summarize pushes=count(), increases=countif(series == prev_series and value > prev), decreases=countif(series == prev_series and value < prev), vmax=max(value), max_value_count=max(valueCount) by series
